req_desc: The console holds the electrical network as a versioned model ...
An `operator` acknowledges alarms inside an assigned operating area ...
The sign-in surface takes an email address, relays the credential to the identity provider ...
A successful sign-in stores the subject identifier, the email, the display name, the realm roles on the session ...
Every request resolves role plus assigned areas from the token on the server ...
Signing out ends the session ...
A session expires `12` hours after creation
The app stores no password, offers no signup, no reset, no invitation
Elements, connectivity, operating areas belong to a model version identified by an increasing integer train ...
A published version is immutable, with no edit path ...
A `coordinator` moves a `ready` version to `pending_approval` by approving ...
Publishing is refused whenever any switching order sits in `executing` or in `suspended`, naming every blocking order
Publishing leaves orders, permits, study runs pinned to the version each was created against
Every measurement sample carries a value, an observed instant, a received instant, a quality flag, a source ...
A point whose newest sample is older than the expected period is marked stale, with the reading age shown
A measurement history request over a wide window returns a minimum plus a maximum per bucket, saying so ...
Only a machine identity holding the ingest scope writes a measurement ...
Alarm rules are evaluated continuously against arriving measurements ...
Two operators acknowledging one alarm together produce exactly one acknowledgement ...
Suppressing needs a reason of `8` to `500` characters ...
An operator acting on an alarm outside the assigned areas is denied with the code `OUT_OF_AREA`, leaving the alarm row unchanged
The seeded incident is `INC-4471` at urgency 2 in state `open` with no commander
A `coordinator` assumes command by sending the command version believed current, becoming commander when that version still holds ...
The incident timeline is append-only, ordered by a server-assigned sequence gapless within the incident ...
Closing an incident is refused whenever an attached order sits in `executing` or in `suspended` ...
An outage impact snapshot still resolving renders a minimum plus a maximum, never a midpoint ...
Reading the sensitive customer register writes a record entry carrying the count returned, never the identities
An order pins the currently published model version at the moment of creation ...
A step names an element by stable key plus an action drawn from the eight permitted actions ...
The order carries a digest over the ordered step list, recomputed whenever a step changes
A study returns for each step the predicted post-step state, the customers de-energized, the per-conductor loading against rating, any violation ...
Submitting moves the order to `pending_approval`, recording the digest submitted
An approval records the exact step-sequence digest approved ...
An `operator` session calling approve on any order is denied ...
An identity approving an order that identity created at risk class 2 or above is refused with the code `SELF_APPROVAL_DENIED` ...
Risk class is computed on the server, never calculated nor overridden by the client ...
Two identities approving one order together produce exactly one approval record ...
Executing a step needs a confirmation token minted for that step plus that identity, valid `120` seconds, usable once ...
An execute whose approved digest differs from the current digest is refused with the code `APPROVAL_HASH_MISMATCH` ...
A step is given an idempotency key when the step is created, never when the step is executed ...
A step execution in flight when the process restarts resumes rather than starting again ...
Execution emits a signed instruction, moving the step to `instructed` ...
Publishing a newer model version during an execution leaves the order pinned, showing a non-blocking drift notice naming both trains
An order may be aborted with a reason of `12` to `1000` characters ...
Issuing a permit validates first against live measurements rather than against the order's intent ...
Issuing without a passing validation is refused with the code `SAFETY_VALIDATION_FAILED`, creating no permit
An issued permit stores the value, the quality, the observed instant of every isolating device as of validation
Adding a step that would energize an element inside a live permit's isolated set is refused at authoring time with the code `SAFETY_DOCUMENT_CONFLICT` ...
Releasing a permit needs an explicit all-clear confirmation naming the crew, asserting every crew member is clear ...
A manual position override records a reason of `12` to `500` characters plus a field reference ...
Assigning a leased crew a second time is refused with the code `LEASE_HELD` naming the holder, leaving the first assignment untouched
An assignment whose crew skills miss the required skills is refused unless an override reason is supplied
A crew estimate derived from straight-line distance is labelled straight-line everywhere the estimate appears
Every state-changing action writes one record entry carrying a gapless sequence number, the acting identity, the capability exercised, the outcome ...
The record accepts insertions only, with no role, no endpoint updating nor deleting an entry ...
A chain recomputation over a window returns the bounds, the entry count, the computed root, the expected root, whether both match ...
A state-changing request that cannot be recorded is refused with the code `AUDIT_UNAVAILABLE`, with the state change not occurring
Opening a handover pre-assembles open incidents, unclosed orders, live permits, unreconciled overrides, suppressed alarms, stale study results ...
Every handover item needs a disposition of `carry_forward` or `resolved` with a note of `4` to `2000` characters ...
Accepting a handover transfers ownership of every carried order to the incoming identity in one act ...
A terms page lives at `/terms`, linked from the footer of every page
A first-time visitor is asked once about non-essential cookies, with the answer surviving a reload
Every form rejects invalid input inline, naming the wrong field plus the reason, keeping what was typed, writing nothing
The public sign-in form carries a decoy field `company_website` that a person never fills ...
An unknown address renders the product's own not-found surface with a way back, answering as not found
The sign-in entry lives at `/`, the operations surface at `/console` ...
The operations canvas encodes camera, time cursor, active layers, selection, pinned version, dock occupancy in the query string ...
Every list carries an empty state saying what would fill the list, visually distinct from the loading state ...
The first moment communicates the present electrical state of the network plus which part is under somebody's hand ...
The client is built with SolidJS compiled by Vite into a production bundle ...
Twenty-eight tables hold the product's state, with every timestamp in UTC ...
The seeded operating areas are `Northgate`, `Harbourside` ...
One loop at the root drives camera integration, the canvas redraw, overlay reconciliation, chart drawing, every interface animation ...
Four roles exist, with the planning engineer, the platform administrator, the executive sponsor out of scope ...
The app is reachable at `APP_PUBLIC_URL` ...
